offers_products.reason: Sells delivered electricity, natural gas and steam as energy products through its regulated utilities.

offers_services.reason: Regulated electric, gas and steam utility service, plus transmission investment; utilities count as services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Con Edison of New York and O&R supply electricity and gas to millions of households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Utilities also serve commercial, industrial and government customers, such as buildings and steam users in Manhattan.

recurring_revenue.reason: Customers pay continuing monthly bills for electric, gas and steam utility service.

cyclical_demand.reason: Electricity, gas and steam are essential regulated services that customers cannot easily postpone.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay small, frequent monthly utility bills.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for energy delivered over the grid, pipes and steam network, not mainly for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are millions of households and small and mid-sized businesses in New York City and Westchester.

asset_heavy.reason: Regulated electric, gas and steam utility needs continuous heavy investment in grid, pipes and transmission.
